hard_gates: Local persistence accepts one validated approved record only; secrets, unverified inference, unrelated context, external synchronization, and indefinite retention are blocked.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.

Context storage is opt-in per record and project; secrets, unrelated sessions, unverified claims, indefinite retention, cross-machine sync, and external services are blocked under this local-only identity.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Validated record, project identity, local destination, privacy and retention policy, and local-system write authorization.
Project identity, context artifacts, privacy boundary, retention, synchronization mode, and local-system write authorization when persistence is requested.
outputs: read-back, hash, conflict, and rollback evidence
normalized record in the store's schema, or in a labelled proposed schema
local project context or learning records
search, restore, prune, or reconciliation result
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 2 related modes: Persist one validated evidence-bounded learning, metric, review outcome, or project-context record to one approved local destination under privacy, retention, deletion, and rollback controls.; Restore, search, prune, or reconcile records inside one project-isolated local context store under privacy, retention, provenance, and deletion controls; writes of new records route to local-learning-persistence.
